title: ErrorResponse
description: Body returned with Content-Type: application/json when a render request is rejected by the service itself. Requests rejected before they reach the endpoint (malformed JSON, wrong Content-Type, wrong method, unknown path) get an empty body instead, so a client must not assume every non-200 response carries this shape.

timestamp.description: Instant the error was produced, in UTC ISO-8601 form.

status.description: HTTP status code, repeated in the body.

message.description: What went wrong, safe to show to a user or to act on. Stable prefixes: 'reportFileName is required', 'reportFileName must have a .jrxml extension', 'Report file not found: ', 'Invalid reportFileName: ', 'Subreport not found in the reports directory: ', 'Subreport cycle: ', 'Failed to read report file: ', 'Failed to obtain a database connection for the report: ', 'Failed to compile or render the report: '.
examples: Failed to compile or render the report: Error evaluating expression for source text: $P{pInt} + 1
